drills.notes: Missing trust-hook evidence withholds the template claim rather than letting an ungated hook run during hydration.

steps.narration: The template declares a lifecycle hook with no trust-gate evidence binding it to the execution-scope and authority contracts.
Trust-hooks evidence is observed missing for the template profile.
The certification withholds the template claim; hydration is blocked until the hook is trust-gated rather than silently executed.
The hook is bound to its trust gate and the evidence is restored.
Trust-hooks evidence returns current; the claim recovers to its stable maturity.
The recovered posture matches the certification engine for a fully current template row.

drills.title: Template hydration is withheld when trust-hook evidence is missing

drills.notes: Partial source-digest coverage narrows the starter claim to beta without withholding it.

steps.narration: The starter's source digest covers only part of its defining inputs after a seed input changes under it.
Source-digest evidence is observed partial for the starter profile.
The certified claim narrows to beta; the starter labels the capsule as partially identified and keeps warm reuse at partial.
The source digest is recomputed across the remaining inputs.
Source-digest evidence returns current; the claim recovers to stable.
The recovered posture matches the certification engine for a fully current starter row.

drills.title: Starter narrows to beta on partial source-digest coverage

drills.notes: A stale prebuild fingerprint narrows the maturity to preview and forces a cold build, never letting an approximate warm snapshot imply trustworthy reuse.

steps.narration: The source digest advances while the prebuild snapshot stays pinned, so its fingerprint trails the current source.
Prebuild-fingerprint evidence is observed stale for the prebuild profile.
The certified claim narrows to preview and the warm-start posture drops to a cold build; the stale snapshot is invalidated instead of being served as current truth.
The prebuild is rebuilt and re-fingerprinted against the current source digest.
Prebuild-fingerprint evidence returns current; the claim recovers to beta with full warm reuse.
The recovered posture matches the certification engine for a fully current prebuild row.

drills.title: Prebuild narrows to preview and cold-builds when its fingerprint goes stale

drills.notes: Stale service-graph evidence narrows the devcontainer claim below beta even though it worked once on a happy-path capture.

steps.narration: The devcontainer's declared service graph ages past its freshness window after a service definition changes.
Service-graph evidence is observed stale for the devcontainer profile.
The certified claim narrows to preview; the devcontainer labels its service graph stale rather than implying the whole environment.
The service graph is recaptured from the devcontainer definition.
Service-graph evidence returns current; the claim recovers to its beta maturity.
The recovered posture matches the certification engine for a fully current devcontainer row.

drills.title: Devcontainer narrows to preview when its service graph ages out

drills.notes: A stale toolchain plan narrows the remote-container claim to preview until it is re-pinned against the current host.

steps.narration: The pinned toolchain plan ages past its freshness window after the remote host's base image rolls.
Toolchain-plan evidence is observed stale for the remote-container profile.
The certified claim narrows to preview until the toolchain plan is re-pinned against the current host.
The toolchain plan is re-pinned against the rolled base image.
Toolchain-plan evidence returns current; the claim recovers to its beta maturity.
The recovered posture matches the certification engine for a fully current remote-container row.

drills.title: Remote container narrows to preview when its toolchain plan goes stale

drills.notes: Materialization skew narrows the managed-workspace claim to preview; warm reuse stays unchanged because the prebuild fingerprint is still current.

steps.narration: The managed-workspace materialization diverges from the capsule object the desktop and support surfaces read.
Materialization-parity evidence is observed stale for the managed-workspace profile.
The certified claim narrows to preview; the managed row is labeled skewed rather than presented as aligned live truth.
The materialization is re-aligned with the capsule object and the parity evidence is recaptured.
Materialization-parity evidence returns current; the claim recovers to its beta maturity.
The recovered posture matches the certification engine for a fully current managed-workspace row.

drills.title: Managed workspace narrows to preview on materialization skew

freshness_rules.effect: A claimed profile with partial evidence on any required dimension narrows to at most a beta claim.
freshness_rules.rationale: Partial environment evidence proves only part of the claimed capsule, so the profile may not present a stable environment guarantee.

freshness_rules.effect: A claimed profile with stale evidence on any required dimension narrows to at most a preview claim.
freshness_rules.rationale: Stale environment evidence may no longer reflect the current source or platform truth, so the profile drops below beta until the evidence is refreshed.

freshness_rules.effect: A claimed profile missing evidence on any required dimension is withheld; promotion fails until the dimension is proven.
freshness_rules.rationale: A required environment dimension with no backing evidence cannot be proven, so the profile may not be promoted at its claimed maturity.

invariants: Each claimed M5 environment profile is certified only when every required capsule dimension — source digest, target plan, toolchain plan, trust hooks, service graph, prebuild fingerprint, and materialization parity — is proven current.

One narrowing engine folds per-dimension evidence into a verdict and a warm-start posture: partial evidence narrows to beta, stale evidence narrows to preview, missing evidence withholds the claim, and stale or partial source/prebuild evidence narrows warm reuse.
Prebuilds are accelerators rather than authorities: a warm-full-reuse claim drops to partial reuse or a cold build whenever the source digest or prebuild fingerprint outruns current truth.

Templates cannot invent a parallel execution model and lifecycle hooks stay trust-gated; a profile absent from the packet is uncertified rather than implicitly green, and the certification only narrows, never widens.
Release, support, docs, and help all read the same per-row verdict, warm-start posture, and narrowing tokens instead of re-deriving environment staleness.
Failure and recovery drills exercise each profile through narrowing and back, computed from the same engine so the certification, drills, and fixtures cannot disagree.

dimensions.rationale: The capsule is identified by a typed, versioned digest of its defining inputs, so its identity is inspectable, diffable, and mirrorable rather than implied by side effects.
The capsule declares its materialization target plan — local, container, remote, devcontainer, or managed — instead of inferring the target from whatever happened to run.
The capsule pins a deterministic toolchain plan of language and runtime versions and components, so the same capsule resolves the same toolchain across surfaces.
Lifecycle hooks are declared and trust-gated against the execution-scope and authority contracts, never silently executed during template hydration or warm start.
The capsule declares the service graph it materializes — services, ports, and dependencies — so a partial graph is labeled partial rather than presented as the whole environment.
Prebuild reuse is validated against the source-digest fingerprint and invalidates when the fingerprint drifts, so a prebuild stays an accelerator rather than an authority.
Runtime materialization stays semantically aligned with the same capsule object consumed by desktop, CLI, AI, support, and managed rows instead of forking a parallel model.

surface_bindings.summary: The shiproom dashboard reads the per-row verdict, effective maturity, and warm-start posture and holds promotion for any narrowed or withheld release-scope environment profile.
The metadata-first support bundle re-exports the per-row verdict, narrowing tokens, warm-start posture, and stale-or-missing dimensions without raw paths, credentials, or provider payloads.
The reviewer documentation quotes the certified dimensions, freshness and warm-start rules, and per-row verdicts directly from the packet.
The in-product why-this-environment inspector reuses the same verdict and warm-start vocabulary so help never tells a greener story than the packet.

title: Environment-capsule, template, prebuild-fingerprint, and runtime-materialization governance for claimed M5 environment profiles

warm_start_rules.effect: Partial source-digest or prebuild-fingerprint evidence narrows the warm-start posture to at most partial reuse.
warm_start_rules.rationale: A partially proven fingerprint cannot prove the whole cached environment matches the current source, so only part of the environment may be reused.

warm_start_rules.effect: Stale source-digest or prebuild-fingerprint evidence forces a cold build.
warm_start_rules.rationale: A stale fingerprint can no longer prove the cached artifact matches the current source, so the environment must be rebuilt rather than served warm.

warm_start_rules.effect: Missing source-digest or prebuild-fingerprint evidence forces a cold build.
warm_start_rules.rationale: Without a source digest or fingerprint the environment cannot be identified for reuse, so warm start is unavailable and the environment is rebuilt cold.
